key.name: new-note
key.summary: Create a note at the pointer

key.name: notes-hidden
key.summary: Global visibility of sticky notes between GNOME sessions

key.name: sink-unfocused
key.summary: Raise the focused note above the other notes
key.description: Notes stay on the desktop, underneath application windows.

key.name: pin-new-notes
key.description: Newly created notes start pinned above ordinary application windows. Individual notes can still be unpinned from the note menu.

key.name: note-width
key.summary: Width of a newly created note

key.name: note-height
key.summary: Height of a newly created note

key.name: max-width
key.description: About 48 characters at the normal text size. Can be raised up to 960.

key.name: todo-file
key.summary: Path of the todo.txt file mirrored as a TODO note
key.description: Paths starting with ~/ resolve against the user home directory. An empty value disables the TODO note. The file is kept as a plain todo.txt; note appearance is stored in todo-layout.

key.name: todo-layout
key.summary: Saved layout of the TODO note, as JSON
key.description: Owned by the extension. Position, size, color, font size, pin/lock state and workspace of the TODO note. Leave empty to reset to defaults.

key.name: max-height
key.description: About 20 lines at the normal text size. Can be raised up to 1200.
